name: notes_write
title: notes.write
description: Record procedural or environmental knowledge that is expensive to re-derive, scoped to a repository and surviving across runs. Returns a note_* id, NOT an evidenceId — notes are structurally uncitable in findings.record. Write a note when a later agent would otherwise repeat work you already did: how this project bootstraps its fixtures, that harnesses at a given entry point need a config file, that this repo references issues as CSV-nnn rather than #nnn. Do NOT write claims about bugs; the kind enum has no member for them, and that is on purpose.

repoSlug.description: owner/name — notes are per-repository and persist across runs.

subject.description: What the note is about — a build tool, an entry point, a commit convention. Used for retrieval.

supersedes.description: Mark an earlier note obsolete rather than accumulating contradictory advice.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.
